grading: Picks are graded once the game is final. Ambiguous stays Pending.
Void = inactive/scratched player or postponed/cancelled game (no carry-over). Never void a POTD for price drift.
Parlay is L as soon as any leg loses. Runners-up removed mid-game are dropped, not graded.
results: Exactly three groups: Official, Edge and Unofficial. Each shows its record broken down by prop type.
Official = our posted POTD and Parlay +100 tickets (chains included), every ticket leg from the leg tracker, and the user's placed Hard Rock tickets in their own "Placed tickets" section.
Edge = its own section, one result per Edge pick, broken down by prop type.

Unofficial = runners-up, alt lines, Safe +100 test tickets, NRFI calls, Home Field, Lotto Ticket and cappers. A Safe +100 ticket or Lotto Ticket the user placed counts in Official (Placed tickets) instead, never in both.
Live plays (Live POTD, Live Parlay +100, in-game and live calls) are never tracked on Results or Record.

Count every ticket once. A placed ticket that is the same bet as our posted POTD or Parlay +100 (same legs, about the same price) merges into that posted ticket and carries its slip. A placed ticket that only shares a leg with a posted ticket is its own ticket. A leg that is the same play as that day's POTD counts once.
Headline record = ticket count (one result per POTD, ticket or Edge pick). Official also shows its leg record small underneath.
Units = 1u flat per pick: win +1, loss -1, push or void 0.
Sport filter chips: All, NFL, NHL, MLB, NBA, WNBA, NCAAF, NASCAR. Mixed-sport (Big 4) tickets show under All.

By prop: rare prop types merge into families (Receiving yds, Rushing yds, Receptions, Pass yds, Anytime TD, SOG, Saves, Pitcher Ks, Hits/TB, ML, Spread, Total, Team total, NASCAR finish...), sorted by volume. The top 8 show, the rest sit behind "Show more".
Summary strip: Today / This week / All-time record and units, plus Best streak, Hottest prop and Coldest prop callouts (a prop needs 3+ decisions).
Money bag on hits, color-coded result chips, voided picks read "VOID" (never "PUSH"), and saved Hard Rock slips link from their tickets.
Collapse standard: days and props load collapsed to a one-line summary. A collapsed Rules dropdown sits at the bottom.
The Results data is rebuilt from the ledgers on every data rebuild (never hard-coded).
